nativeCapture.source: Native AudioRenderer main mix and composited GameView, no normalization or substituted audio.
nativeCapture.fixture: Four spaced accepted hits by an autonomous ShadowStalker, no firing. Player held at original spawn with temporary 100HP and aim at the enemy; other enemies disabled only during Play. Attacks stopped after hit four, with a 1.2s tail. Attack timing/damage/assets unchanged.
nativeCapture.auditionBank: One source for this audition, repeated on four real hits; not a completed variation bank. Only the memory-copy clip bank changes; production gain/pitch/routing retained.
nativeCapture.captureTiming: Per-frame audio sample count follows unscaled time; video uses those sample durations.

processing: Unchanged native float32 samples; PCM24 WAV and AAC video encode, no gain/normalization
